steps.body: Pat the chicken thighs (1 1/2 lb) dry and season all over with 1 tsp salt.
Sear the chicken thighs skin-side down in 2 tbsp olive oil until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic (4 cloves), squeeze in the lemon (2), and scrape up the brown bits.
Brown the ground beef (1 lb) with the onion (1).
Stir in 2 tbsp chili powder and 1 tsp cumin until fragrant.
Add 2 cups crushed tomatoes and 3 cups kidney beans; simmer 25 minutes.
Toss the broccoli (1 lb) in 2 tbsp soy sauce; roast with the salmon fillet (1 lb) 12 minutes.
Warm 1 lb cherry tomatoes in 1 tbsp olive oil until they do not burst.
Toss with 8 oz mozzarella and basil off the heat.
